description: Source code for Wi-Fi client HAL implementation on Raspberry Pi, including WPA control and event handling.

classes.name: struct ctrl
classes.description: Represents control interface for WPA supplicant communication, including socket paths, callbacks, and event handling.

methods.name: ctrl_close
methods.description: Closes the WPA control connection and stops associated event watchers.

methods.name: ctrl_process
methods.description: Processes received WPA supplicant events and invokes callbacks for connection or disconnection.

methods.name: ctrl_ev_cb
methods.description: Event callback for WPA control socket, reads and processes events.

methods.name: ctrl_open
methods.description: Initializes and opens WPA control connection, sets up event watchers.

methods.name: ctrl_request
methods.description: Sends a command to WPA supplicant and retrieves the response.

methods.name: ctrl_watchdog_cb
methods.description: Periodic watchdog to check WPA connection health.

methods.name: ctrl_stat_cb
methods.description: Handles file state changes for WPA control socket.

methods.name: ctrl_retry_cb
methods.description: Retries connection to WPA control socket if initial attempt fails.

methods.name: ctrl_enable
methods.description: Enables WPA control interface and event monitoring.

methods.name: wifi_getSTANumberOfEntries
methods.description: Returns the number of configured Wi-Fi stations.

methods.name: wifi_getSTAName
methods.description: Retrieves the interface name for a given station index.

methods.name: wifi_getSTARadioIndex
methods.description: Calculates radio index based on station index.

methods.name: wifi_getSTAMAC
methods.description: Gets MAC address of a station via wpa_cli command.

methods.name: wifi_getSTABSSID
methods.description: Gets BSSID of a station via wpa_cli command.

methods.name: wifi_getSTASSID
methods.description: Gets SSID of a station via wpa_cli command.

methods.name: wifi_getSTACredentials
methods.description: Gets Wi-Fi credentials of a station via wpa_cli command.

methods.name: init_client_wpa
methods.description: Initializes WPA control interfaces for all stations.

methods.name: wifi_client_event_callback_register
methods.description: Registers callback for Wi-Fi client connection events.

methods.name: wifi_getSTANetworks
methods.description: Reads Wi-Fi network configurations from file.

methods.name: wifi_setSTANetworks
methods.description: Writes Wi-Fi network configurations to file and reconfigures WPA.

methods.name: wifi_getSTAEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a station interface is enabled.

methods.name: wifi_setSTAEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a station interface.
